'''Wukkar''' was a heavily-populated [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Wukkar system/Legends|Wukkar system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Part of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] since the Republic's inception, Wukkar became a part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] until surrendering to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It was later occupied by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
Wukkar was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Wukkar system/Legends|same name]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], situated along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] between the [[Ixtlar system/Legends|Ixtlar]] and [[Kailor system/Legends|Kailor systems]]; this made it a part of the Core Worlds portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] known as the [[Arrowhead]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was one of the most highly populated worlds in the Core;<ref name="DESB" /> planets in its [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] averaged between 100 and 500 billion inhabitants in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
Wukkar was located in a region of the Core that was explored by [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] society prior to the formation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It remained in space controlled by the Republic for nearly 25,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]], until the Republic [[New Order/Legends|gave way]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] regime in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

Up until [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the planet's capital, [[Iltarr City]], was the home of [[Avrak Villachor]], the local [[Sector chief/Legends|sector chief]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate. However, after a [[Marblewood Estate heist|heist]] at [[Marblewood Estate|his estate]], most of his [[Marblewood security force|forces]] were killed or scattered. Villachor agreed to cooperate with the Empire and left the Black Sun after that event.<ref name="Scoundrels" />

The Empire was opposed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], which scored a major victory at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Afterward, the Alliance reorganized itself as the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], which pressed on with its [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] against the Empire. Wukkar was one of the Core Worlds, along with [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]], and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], that surrendered fairly quickly to a New Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]].<ref name="DESB" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] of [[25 ABY/Legends|25]]&ndash;[[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], Wukkar was one of many planets in the Slice occupied by the invading [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. In the last two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of the war, [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|Yuuzhan Vong forces]] began to pull back from the Slice. This allowed the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the successor state of the New Republic, to [[Battle of Corulag (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attack]] the Yuuzhan Vong forces occupying the planet [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]].<ref name="TUF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wukkar was created in a lone statement about the Core Worlds in the ''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Michael Allen Horne]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[1993]]. It would not be mentioned again until another stand-alone mention in the [[2003]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]'', written by [[James Luceno]], followed by an entry in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' and a map placement for the Wukkar system in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.
